title: Compile quantum amplitudes and marginals with variables only at Hadamards
statement: A diagonal gate adds a local phase and no variable; each Hadamard adds one path bit. Paired-path marginals use at most2h_H bits; endpoint pins/equalities are eliminated without multiplicity, and padding to n+2h_H preserves the original-qubit bound.

requires: h_H<=Cn, fixed locality/root order, explicit gates and requested output
provides: A diagonal gate adds a local phase and no variable; each Hadamard adds one path bit. Paired-path marginals use at most2h_H bits; endpoint pins/equalities are eliminated without multiplicity, and padding to n+2h_H preserves the original-qubit bound.
assumptions: Arbitrary geometry/alternation within this gate-count contract
No uncharged conversion of generic gate sets
costs: Exact normalization2^-h_H or2^(-h_H/2); padding division only after reconstruction
Finite state-vector checks are not an asymptotic solver
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: A variable per diagonal gate would erase the original-input benefit.

body: Union-find handles equal endpoints; constant wires and inconsistent pins are checked. Conditional on the phase theorem.
